text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe injures herself during
training, so
I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I was being careless... and
now I've
hurt myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What was that? I should keep on
training?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... but someone else did. Someone
who seems
very... passionate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like someone from the beyond
is
communicating with Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I need to "power through"? It's true, I'll
need a
great deal more passion if I'm
going to make this
work...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With enough passion... Maybe I could
make a
miracle happen...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With enough passion... Maybe I could
make a
miracle happen...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But... if I power through, I could...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe

If it gets worse, running will be ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right... I'll pass on the
message...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They're... moved... and sorry for being
mistaken...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It makes me happy to hear you say that.
I promise
I'll rest up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I should power through... Okay...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll show you how much power I—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It looks like I don't have enough
passion to
make it happen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I can't let her strain her
injury any
further, I have Manhattan
Cafe take some time
off to fully recover.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What do you have in mind?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think... I could do some studying, or
stretching...
choice_data_list: What can you give your all to righ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Would... those still count as "powering
through"?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Very efficient. Doing what training I
can... while
still letting myself recover...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The passionate one likes your
approach.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll power through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While putting her all into a manageable
training
regimen, Manhattan Cafe heals
up wonderfully.
